NewsArticle.Title: Rebel's Needs
NewsArticle.Content:
The mercenaries orcs, goblins, and Champions have laid siege to Undine.
Hali, higgler of Undine, said, "We're dying on our feet to defend our village and our way of life from the tyrannical onslaught. We desparately need your help and supplies. Help us, this moon, o! help us."
((Levels 49 or less))
